quip: Launch a damaging cloak that you can teleport to
text: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies. You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

quip: Briefly escape into your suitcase, then deal damage

tiers.text: +1.5s Duration +4m Radius -32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4.0s

quip: Apply damage over time to enemies nearby

name: Royal Pestments
text: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker. The barrier does not benefit from resists.

tiers.text: Reduce all damage to a max of 250 +10% Max Health as Barrier

name: Rule, Ratannia!
text: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.

name: Pillow Toss
text: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback. Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

name: Tag Along
text: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration. Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

tiers.text: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping Improved Spirit Scaling

name: Lil Helpers
text: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed. Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

name: Naptime
text: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.

tiers.text: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

name: Lightning Ball
quip: Launch a damaging ball of lightning

tiers.text: +3m Move Speed +8 Damage and increased scaling

quip: Fry all enemies in a large area

tiers.text: +6 m Range +2 m/s in Full Rage.

name: Setup Bishop
text: Create a bishop that remains in place indefinitely. Move ([Alt Fire]): Moves the bishop, applying a fading slow and dealing spirit damage to enemies it passes through. tiers.text: +1 Square Range Squares reduce Spirit Resist by -2.5%, stacking 10 times

name: Kingside Knight
text: Promote an ally to be a knight, granting bonus stamina and barrier for a duration. If self-cast you develop yourself as king instead, granting double the barrier but no stamina. Move ([Alt Fire]): Moves the piece, making it invulnerable during the duration before landing. If self-cast, re-activate the ability to move instead.

tiers.text: Can target two allies within radius. On Self: Remove all debuffs after a move

name: Rook Battery
